reason: Self-owned JUnit IRQ negative test restores its own flag in finally; independentConnectionsInParallel owns fixed pool2, bounded Future3s and joins before fixture assertions. No deployed actor/Root thread or container worker.

finding.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation

lineText: final Map<String, Throwable> failures = new HashMap<>();
reason: Per-Fixture instance map, one invoking worker/caller only. Parallel cases allocate distinct Fixture inside each task; parent reads only after Future.get happens-before. No shared concurrent map, ConcurrentHashMap would introduce unsupported sharing implication.

finding.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected. Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.

reason: Standalone JDK interface Proxy deliberately uses that exact public interface loader, which sees the interface; no servlet/J2EE container/TCCL lookup or application provider loading. Actual same fixture compile/runtime is separately qualified.
